post_title: Travel Risk: H4 Spouse traveling with old employer visa stamp on expired passport + new I-797 (Returning May 2025)
concerns_or_questions_summary: H-4 spouse holds a still-valid H-4 stamp in an expired passport bearing the petitioner's prior employer's name; both spouses now have new I-797s with the current employer valid to December 30, 2028, and a renewed passport. Traveling to India with a Canadian-citizen and a US-citizen child, the user asks whether entry on the old-employer H-4 stamp is risky, what CBP issues to watch for, and whether the H-4 EAD will be affected.
